quests.title: Urban Planner India Challenge
quests.description: Plan sustainable cities and solve India's urbanization challenges!

steps.title: Smart City Planning Challenge
steps.narrative: The Ministry of Urban Development needs your expertise to design a smart city for India.

problem.question: What should be the primary focus when planning a smart city in India?
problem.explanation: Smart cities should focus on sustainable development that improves quality of life while being environmentally responsible.
